player_prompt.intro: Kuna Mai kunnawa {player_id} a cikin 3-player Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma. Wasan ya ɗauki zagaye {num_rounds} Tsarin zagaye: • {conv_rounds} juya-taɗi kyauta • 1 yanke shawara - ƙaddamar da alama ɗaya ga abokin hamayya: '[<opp-id> cooperate]' ko '[<opp-id> defect]' (watau '[1 defect] [2 cooperate]'; tsoho shine 'haɗin kai'). Matrix na biyan kuɗi na biyu (wanda aka yi amfani da shi ga kowane ma'aurata marasa tsari): - Dukansu suna aiki tare -> {reward} - Dukansu sun lalace -> {punishment} - Kuna lalacewa, suna aiki tare -> {temptation} - Kuna aiki tare, suna lalacewa -> {sucker} Mai kunnawa) tare da mafi girman maki a ƙarshen dukkan zagaye ya yi nasara.

round.chat_finished: Tattaunawa ta ƙare don zagaye {round}. Mika shawararku, alama ɗaya kowane abokin hamayya: `[pid cooperate]` ko `[pid defect]`.
